title: Hiker Trekked 10 Miles to Safety After Impaling Himself on Pole
summary: David Cifaldi was hiking up Granite Peak, Montana’s tallest mountain, last week when he slipped and fell on one of his trekking poles. A wound nurse, he went into survival mode.
